meta.name: a11y-audit
meta.description: Accessibility audit skill for scanning, fixing, and verifying WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA compliance across React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and plain HTML codebases. Use when auditing accessibility, fixing a11y violations, checking color contrast, generating compliance reports, or integrating accessibility checks into CI/CD pipelines.

copy.tagline: 扫描并修复网页无障碍违规，生成合规报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发中确保网站符合WCAG无障碍标准
copy.tagline_en: Scan and fix web accessibility violations, generate compliance reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your website meets WCAG accessibility standards during development

howto.what: Claude 会扫描你的代码库，找出所有 WCAG 2.2 Level A 和 AA 无障碍违规，按严重程度分类，并给出针对 React、Vue 等框架的修复代码。它还能检查颜色对比度、生成合规报告，并集成到 CI/CD 流程中。
howto.when: 当你要求审计无障碍性、修复 a11y 违规、检查颜色对比度、生成合规报告，或希望将无障碍检查加入 CI/CD 流水线时触发。

say.text: 审计这个项目的无障碍性。
say.note: Claude 会扫描项目并列出所有违规。

say.text: 检查 #777777 前景色在白色背景上的对比度。
say.note: Claude 会计算对比度并判断是否通过 AA 标准。
Claude 会输出一份适合利益相关者阅读的报告。

howto.what_en: Claude scans your codebase for all WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA accessibility violations, categorizes them by severity, and provides framework-specific fix code for React, Vue, etc. It also checks color contrast, generates compliance reports, and integrates into CI/CD pipelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit accessibility, fix a11y violations, check color contrast, generate compliance reports, or integrate accessibility checks into CI/CD.

say_en.text: Audit this project for accessibility issues.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the project and list all violations.

say_en.text: Check contrast ratio of #777777 on white background.
say_en.note: Claude will compute the ratio and tell if it passes AA.
Claude will output a stakeholder-ready report.
